# Gather reggae artists again from all songs in library playlists
page_limit=20
all_playlists=[]
i=0
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=i,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    i+=1

song_ids=set()
for p in all_playlists:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'],access_token=token)
    for s in pl.get('songs',[]):
        song_ids.add(s['id'])

reggae_artist_ids=set()
reggae_songs=[]
for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=song.get('genre','') or ''
    if 'reggae' in str(genre).lower():
        reggae_songs.append(sid)
        for a in song.get('artists',[]):
            reggae_artist_ids.add(a['id'])

print('reggae_song_count',len(reggae_songs))
print('reggae_artist_ids',sorted(reggae_artist_ids))

# Follow any not already followed
followed=[]
already=[]
for aid in sorted(reggae_artist_ids):
    is_following=apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid,access_token=token)['following']
    if is_following:
        already.append(aid)
    else:
        apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid,access_token=token)
        followed.append(aid)

print('already',already)
print('followed_now',followed)
